description: This file defines the MainActivity class for an Android application, managing UI components like toolbar, navigation drawer, bottom navigation, and fragment switching. It handles permissions, navigation item selection, and lifecycle events.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity managing the primary user interface with navigation drawer, bottom navigation, and fragment switching logic.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up toolbar, drawer, bottom navigation, and permissions.

methods.name: onPostCreate
methods.description: Synchronizes drawer toggle state after activity restoration.

methods.name: onConfigurationChanged
methods.description: Propagates configuration changes to the drawer toggle.

methods.name: onNavigationItemSelected
methods.description: Handles navigation drawer item selections, switching fragments accordingly.

methods.name: onBackPressed
methods.description: Handles back button presses, closing the drawer if open.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Handles runtime permission request results, providing user feedback.

methods.name: switchTo
methods.description: Helper method to switch the displayed fragment.
